title: Remulla urges PNP to prepare for possible scenarios in impeachment trial
summary: MANILA – Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Monday reminded Philippine National Police (PNP) personnel to remain prepared for any eventuality as the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte…

blocks.text: MANILA – Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla on Monday reminded Philippine National Police (PNP) personnel to remain prepared for any eventuality as the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte and the upcoming elections could pose security challenges. “We have an issue coming up. Make sure that whatever the decision is, our actions will be the same. Next year, the election cycle will begin, and the challenge of police work will be there again,” Remulla told reporters in Filipino on the sidelines of a ceremony recognizing the PNP’s peace and order efforts during last week’s 49th ASEAN Summit and Related Summits, held […]...
